title: Sự thay đổi của TPHCM trong 320 năm qua những tấm bản đồ cổ
publisher: Dân trí, 1/12/2018 (exhibition by Sở TT&TT TP.HCM)
note: 15 panels at 960 px; 12 carry a Vietnamese translation of the map's legend or key (1790/1799 Brun–Dayot A–X, 1870 1–25, 1873, 1878, 1882 and 1898 cadastral colour classes, 1893 1–40, 1920 about 40 keys, 1922 road legend) plus title, scale and makers; 1895 and 1912 title only. Panels for VMA's 1878, 1882 cadastral, 1898 and 1922 sheets can check VMA's own legend readings; the translations are the exhibition's work, so cite, do not copy. Map leads L29–L31; the 1911 Environs de Saigon and the 1920 Saigon plan are new to VMA. The 1790 panel credits Olivier 1790 / Dayot 1799 from Brun, against VMA's "surveyed 1795"
